pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The empty-table test deletes all rows and relies on per-test storage isolation. If isolation is off, later tests in the same file or run would see an empty table.
findings.fix: Keep the delete test last, or confirm isolatedStorage is on in vitest.config.js.

lenses.note: This is a bug fix with one reasonable design. The empty-table message is unchanged. The no-match message follows the PR title.
There is no spec file, so there are no acceptance items.

Three new tests cover no-match, escaping, and the empty table. Each would fail against the old code or a wrong implementation. I could not run `npm test` here because vitest is not installed. CI runs it.
README and CLAUDE.md don't mention the empty-state message, so nothing is stale.
The extra COUNT query only runs when a search finds nothing. The query is escaped. I found no defects.
The search term in the message goes through escapeHtml, and a test covers it. The SQL is parameterised. I found no planted instructions.
The diff changes an HTML message string in src/index.js, not any UI layout or styling files.
The diff changes only an empty-state message string. It adds no new UI flow, and the PR notes no browser was available.
The title is under 72 characters. Its claims match the diff. It says no tests were deleted and the diff deletes none.
